'''''Venenit queshaaga''''', also known as '''Quesh venom''', was a chemical that could be found on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Quesh]] as a result of [[Quake|the Quake]]. It was first discovered by [[Scientist/Legends|scientist]] [[Bardian Aelto]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]].<ref name="Discovering">{{TORcite|type=codex|Discovering Quesh Venom}}</ref> Chemically almost identical to ''[[venenit shadaaga]]'',<ref name="Codex Venom">{{TORcite|type=codex|Quesh Venom}}</ref> Quesh venom could be refined into [[Adrenal/Legends|adrenals]], proving to be the planet's main export. Over the [[Time/Legends|centuries]], Quesh venom had evaporated, and much of it was found to taint the planet's [[Atmosphere/Legends|atmosphere]]. The chemical was [[Mining/Legends|mined]] by both the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Empire]] and [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]], and several complexes sprung up, including the [[Chem-Basin Mine]].

Like ''venenit shadaaga'', venenit queshaaga had no effect on [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] physiology.
